description: State of Palestine - Ports, Airports and International Crossings is a dataset listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by OCHA occupied Palestinian territory (oPt). Includes ports, airports and international crossings in Palestine with at borders with Egypt and Jordan. Coverage: Israel, Palestine, State of. The portal files it under the publisher OCHA occupied Palestinian territory (oPt). Its tags are aviation, border crossings, crisis-opt-israel-hostilities, ports. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, KMZ. The portal shows 2025-05-05 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution International (CC BY). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
